label: AnAge: The Animal Ageing and Longevity Database, build 15
bibliographic_citation: Tacutu R, Craig T, Budovsky A, Wuttke D, Lehmann G, Taranukha D, Costa J, Fraifeld VE, de Magalhães JP (2013) Human Ageing Genomic Resources: integrated databases and tools for the biology and genetics of ageing. Nucleic Acids Research 41(D1):D1027–D1033.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (per HAGR terms of use)

distributions.note: zip contains anage_data.txt (tab-separated) and release.html (Build 15 release notes dated July 3, 2023)

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled life-history and ageing traits per species (maturity, gestation, litter size, adult weight, maximum longevity, mortality parameters).
role: maximum longevity, body mass and life-history traits for the listed taxa
